g1-implement.title: worktree identity by equality: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md from this gate's plan and anchors. Task: implement the 2026-08-15-worktree-identity ruling in scripts/checklist_engine.py (origin_worktree_refusal predicate + its single call site in main()) and migrate tests/test_spine_origin_isolation.py per the ruling's authorized deviation. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT: attach g1-implement --type implementer-result --field status=<value copied verbatim, lowercase, from Return status>.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers (return status complete)

constraints: Predicate (origin_worktree_refusal) stays pure: no filesystem/clock/subprocess/ambient-cwd read inside it -- test_it_is_pure's co_names forbidden-name list must stay green UNMODIFIED (do not touch that test method).
Comparison changes from here.is_relative_to(root) to equality (here == root); keep the existing os.path.normcase folding.

All impurity (the git call) lives at the single call site in main() (~L3393-3416), resolving engine_cwd to its git worktree toplevel via the existing scripts/checklist_engine.py::_git helper (do not add a second subprocess-git invocation path).

Fail closed: if no git toplevel resolves for cwd and the spine carries origin.worktree, the verb is refused. Origin-less/malformed-origin spines keep the existing fallback and must never raise -- OriginRefusalFallback stays green.

Test migration authorized in exactly one way: the subdirectory-passes property in OriginRefusalPredicate moves UP to a main()-level assertion against a REAL temporary git repo. The synthetic predicate-level subdirectory test is corrected to equality semantics (asserts refusal), not deleted -- reference where the property now lives in its docstring.

`_SpineOnDisk.setUp` (the shared fixture behind RefusesAGuardedVerbFromAForeignTree and TheInProcessMcpDoorShape) must `git init` BOTH `self.worktree` AND `self.foreign` as two distinct real repos (siblings, not nested) -- this is required, not optional: those existing tests currently pass under containment against ungitted directories, and under the new fail-closed rule an ungitted `self.worktree` would make even the same-worktree pass-path tests refuse. Making `self.foreign` its own real repo (not just absent-git) keeps its 'foreign tree refused' assertions exercising the real equality-mismatch path rather than only the fail-closed no-toplevel path -- do not collapse this coverage.

Add ONE new permanent regression test reproducing the exact scenario the ruling closes: a spine stamped to a PRIMARY real git repo, driven from cwd inside a NESTED real git worktree created via `git worktree add` under `<primary>/.worktrees/<slug>` -- must refuse after the fix. Before writing the fix, manually capture red-before evidence (this same scenario, run against the UNMODIFIED engine, showing it currently ALLOWS/passes) and report both the red and the green output verbatim.

Add a fail-closed test at BOTH levels: (a) predicate-level, calling origin_worktree_refusal directly with cwd=None against an origin-carrying spine, asserting refusal (this pins the cwd: str | None contract as a direct unit test, not only observable through main()); (b) main()-level, a spine stamped with origin.worktree driven from a cwd that resolves to no git toplevel at all (a plain non-git tempdir) -- must refuse, must not raise. The 'no toplevel resolved' signal must reach the predicate as cwd=None -- do not re-derive or shortcut the origin-shape check a second time in main() outside the predicate; the predicate remains the single place that interprets origin shape.
Do NOT edit scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py, scripts/mcp_spine_server.py, .mcp.json, or anything under .worktrees/epic-568-441/.
Regenerate the map after the change: python -m scripts.code_map build --root . ; commit map/INDEX.md and map/ids.jsonl only if they moved.

Full Linux suite must be run cache-clean (find . -name __pycache__ -type d -not -path './.git/*' -prune -exec rm -rf {} + first) and must be >= the measured baseline at 453f8492: 3002 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed, 1130 subtests passed.
